_about: Named tasks. 'joints' is the chain that is in play; a result is UNVERIFIED if any of these joints relies on a placeholder card. Side-specific joints get _R / _L added for the arm or legs in use.

tasks.description: Touch the wall outlet with a fingertip
Touch the light switch with a fingertip
Touch the front edge of the shelf with a fingertip
Pull in facing the sink or counter with knees underneath (wheelchair users only)
Pass through the doorway's clear opening
